work: Johannes Kepler — Mysterium Cosmographicum (1596/1621), Strena seu de Nive Sexangula (1611), & Harmonices Mundi Libri V (1619)
editions: Prodromus Dissertationum Cosmographicarum continens Mysterium Cosmographicum (Tübingen: Gruppenbach, 1596; 2nd ed. cum notis authoris, Frankfurt: Kempfer/Tampach, 1621; Frisch Opera Omnia Vol. I, 1858)
Strena seu de Nive Sexangula (Frankfurt: Tampach, 1611; Frisch Opera Omnia Vol. VII, 1868)
Harmonices Mundi Libri V (Linz: Tampach/Plancus, 1619; Frisch Opera Omnia Vol. V, 1864)

entries.kepler_locus: Mysterium Cosmographicum Praefatio (1596, pp. 6–10; Frisch I, pp. 106–109)
entries.topic: July 19, 1595 Graz discovery: equilateral great-conjunction triangle circumscribing and inscribing circles in ratio R_in : R_out = 1 : 2 (Q_in / Q_out = 1/4)
entries.sister_locus: Elements IV.2–5, XIII.12 (equilateral triangle in circle)

entries.kepler_locus: Mysterium Cosmographicum Cap. II & XIV (1596, pp. 22–26, 46–49; Frisch I, pp. 122–125, 148–152)
entries.topic: Curved (Divine sphere) vs. Straight (created polyhedron); Five Platonic Solids nested between the six Copernican orbs with Earth as Circulus mensor omnium
entries.sister_locus: Elements XIII.13–18 (five regular solids & uniqueness proof); Proclus In Euclidem Prologue

entries.kepler_locus: Mysterium Cosmographicum Cap. XII–XIII (1596, pp. 41–45; Frisch I, pp. 142–147)
entries.topic: The Two Great Treasures of Geometry (Pythagorean Theorem & Extreme and Mean Ratio) and Polar-Dual Insphere/Circumsphere Equality (Cube = Octahedron Q = 1/3; Dodecahedron = Icosahedron Q = (5 + 2√5)/15)
entries.sister_locus: Elements I.47, II.11, VI.30, XIII.16–17; Pacioli De Divina Proportione (1509); Quadrance invariants

entries.kepler_locus: Epistola ad Michaelem Mästlinum (Graz, October 1597; Frisch I, p. 377)
entries.topic: The Kepler Right Triangle (1, √φ, φ) in continuous geometric proportion (Q_a = 1, Q_b = φ, Q_c = φ² = 1 + φ) and Mästlin's decimal 1/φ ≈ 0.6180340
entries.sister_locus: geometor.model.get_kepler_field (Q(√φ), x⁴ - x² - 1 = 0); Elements II.11, II.14, VI.8, VI.17

entries.kepler_locus: Strena seu de Nive Sexangula §§1–9 (1611, pp. 3–11; Frisch VII, pp. 715–722)
entries.topic: Sixfold snowflake symmetry, trihedral bee honeycomb bases, and discovery of the space-filling Rhombic Dodecahedron (√2:1) and Golden Rhombic Triacontahedron (φ:1)
entries.sister_locus: Pappus Synagoge V.1–3 (honeycomb planimetry); Pacioli elevated/rhombic polyhedra

entries.kepler_locus: Strena seu de Nive Sexangula §§10–14 (1611, pp. 11–15; Frisch VII, pp. 722–725)
entries.topic: Pomegranate compression, 2D hexagonal 7-circle rosette (kissing number 6), and 3D Cubic/Hexagonal Sphere Close-Packing Conjecture (kissing number 12, density π/(3√2) ≈ 74.048%)
entries.sister_locus: Elementary 6-circle compass rosette around unit circle; 3D FCC Voronoi tessellation

entries.kepler_locus: Strena seu de Nive Sexangula §§15–19 (1611, pp. 15–19; Frisch VII, pp. 725–727)
entries.topic: Pentamerous apple/pear blossoms and self-propagating Fibonacci recurrence 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... converging to the Divine Section φ
entries.sister_locus: Fibonacci parastichy lattices, Cassini identity F_{n+1}F_{n-1} - F_n² = (-1)^n, golden divergence

entries.kepler_locus: Harmonices Mundi Liber I, Prooemium & Defs./Props. I–XLIV (1619, pp. 1–38; Frisch V, pp. 75–114)
entries.topic: Refutation of Ramus on Euclid Book X; Eight Degrees of Geometric Scibilitas (effabilis longitudine, effabilis potentia, mese, binominis/apotome, mizon/elasson) for constructible n-gons (3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 16)
entries.sister_locus: Elements IV.10–16, X.1–115, XIII.1–11; Proclus In Euclidem; Hoenen De Noetica Geometriae

entries.kepler_locus: Harmonices Mundi Liber I, Props. XLV–L (1619, pp. 38–46; Frisch V, pp. 114–125)
entries.topic: Algebraic Inscibilitas of the Regular Heptagon (x³ + x² - 2x - 1 = 0) and critique of Jost Bürgi's cossic chord equation vs. Euclidean plane constructibility
entries.sister_locus: Quadratic radical field extensions vs. irreducible cubic equations (anticipating Gauss 1801 & Wantzel 1837)

entries.kepler_locus: Harmonices Mundi Liber II, Props. I–XXVIII (1619, pp. 47–66; Frisch V, pp. 126–144)
entries.topic: Planar and Solid Congruence: Complete classification of the 11 Archimedean uniform planar tilings, pentagonal/decagonal star tiling Aa, the 13 Archimedean convex solids, and the Small & Great Stellated Dodecahedra ({5/2, 5}, {5/2, 3})
entries.sister_locus: Pappus Synagoge V.19 (13 Archimedean solids); Star pentagram {5/2} & Penrose tilings

entries.kepler_locus: Harmonices Mundi Liber V, Cap. I, III–IX (1619, pp. 177–248; Frisch V, pp. 269–329)
entries.topic: Polyhedral-Harmonic Synthesis, Aphelion/Perihelion Angular-Velocity Consonances (4:5, 5:6, 2:3, 15:16, 24:25, 5:12), and Kepler's Third Law ((T₁/T₂)² = (a₁/a₂)³)
entries.sister_locus: Ptolemy Harmonics Book III; Exact rational power-law invariants
